name: Explain and Resolve
brief: Copilot features for finance teams: explain a purchase invoice variance and plan collections, with every figure computed by Business Central and no findings or emails saved until a person keeps them.
description: Explain & Resolve for Business Central. Business Central computes the facts from its ledgers and ranks them, an AI model explains them and drafts emails, and a person reviews everything before findings or emails are saved. Nothing is ever posted or sent. Needs your own AI provider key: the Claude API is supported, Azure OpenAI is planned.
